title: Personalised Product Search Ranking

blueprintSignals.name: Query-item semantic score
blueprintSignals.definition: cosine of query and item embeddings from a dual encoder
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Embeddings must be trained on pre-period logs

blueprintSignals.name: Item price-rank within query
blueprintSignals.definition: percentile of price among retrieved results
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Compute over the retrieved set not the catalogue

blueprintSignals.name: User-category affinity
blueprintSignals.definition: decayed purchase and click share by category
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Exclude events in the current session after the query

blueprintSignals.name: Slot position (training only)
blueprintSignals.definition: position-bias tower input that is dropped or fixed to slot 1 at inference (PAL)
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: If position leaks into serving features the ranker reproduces the page layout

blueprintSignals.name: Deliverable at pincode
blueprintSignals.definition: bitmap membership for the shopper pincode or dark store
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Inventory stream lag shows sold-out items, so version the bitmaps and log staleness

engineFeatures.meaning: the item the user is looking at now
the last few items in the session, in order
share of recent items in each category
recent interaction counts, corrected for popularity
time per item and traversal pattern used to remove non-human sessions

label: For "Personalised Product Search Ranking": Rank search results to maximise purchases per search session while preserving relevance and catalogue fairness to sellers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on clicks from the current ranker.
